// NEGATIVE fixture — `.replaceAll(` only where a lexer must not see it. Nothing may be reported.
// A line comment: text.replaceAll(' ', '-')
/* A block comment: text.replaceAll(' ', '-') */
const SINGLE = 'text.replaceAll(" ", "-")';
const DOUBLE = "text.replaceAll(' ', '-')";
const TEMPLATE = `use replace with a global regex, never text.replaceAll( )`;
const IN_REGEX = /\.replaceAll\s*\(/;

export function mentionsReplaceAll(source) {
  return /\.replaceAll\s*\(/.test(source);
}

export function slugify(text) {
  return String(text).replace(/ /g, '-');
}

export { SINGLE, DOUBLE, TEMPLATE, IN_REGEX };
